intro.title: A Dubai precast contractor built on delivery
body: Mouldex Precast Contracting L.L.C stands as a provider of comprehensive precast solutions in Dubai, UAE. The company specialises in precast erection contracting and holds an industrial licence for prefabricated houses contracting and technical services.
Led by General Manager Samy Abdel Aziz, whose experience in the precast industry spans more than 20 years, the company has become a reliable and innovative presence in the GCC region.

Led by the seasoned expertise of General Manager Samy Abdel Aziz, who brings over 20 years of experience in the precast industry, the company has emerged as a reliable and innovative force in the GCC region.

The company operates as a private company with an industrial licence for prefabricated houses contracting and technical services works, and its commitment to quality and innovation sets it apart in the market.
